decisions.reason: As a close-to-core bread that stayed visible after launch, it likely met modest aspiration levels and uses existing bakery resources efficiently, so there is limited pressure to discontinue it.
This sweet pastry fits the firm's established confectionery line and, absent signs of poor performance, would usually be retained while management focuses search elsewhere.
Although newer and therefore somewhat less proven, this farmhouse bread is highly aligned with the firm's traditional bread business and can be carried with moderate slack in a growing industry.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen received a gold award, which is a strong signal of performance above aspiration for a seasonal specialty the firm is well equipped to produce.
The premium Christmas stollen also earned a gold award and matches the firm's heritage and festive offering, making discontinuation unlikely unless capacity becomes unusually tight.
